text:
julia kim: quick sync — I'm updating the docs for per-route metering tags. small Q: do we keep header name `X-Redwood-Meter` or move to `X-Rw-Meter`? need to update SDK snippets too.

ben p: we decided on `X-Rw-Meter` in infra meeting last week. forwarding notes. @kai can you confirm?

natalie r: linked the draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 — has initial migration guide and examples.

ben p: suggested curl example:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -H "X-Rw-Meter: tier=gold;route=chat" \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

kai: for node SDK we added `options.meterTag = { tier: 'gold', route: 'chat' }` — should we add both the header and SDK snippets side-by-side?

julia kim: yes, please. also add a 1-line note in pricing -> metering about how tiers map to billing buckets (gold -> premium rate). short, please.

natalie r: will add. also can we include a dashboard link for per-route breakdown? https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage?panel=per_route

docs-bot: docs-lint passed for PR 432 :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: preview deployed: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-432 — reviewable now

julia kim: thanks everyone — i'll push a tiny wording tweak and then merge after 👍
